unlisted_practices: Separating deterministic measurement extraction (signal processing computing exact clinical values before compression) from LLM text generation, with constrained decoding around frozen slots to prevent hallucinated numeric values in EEG reports

screen.reason: The paper develops and benchmarks a novel hybrid multimodal AI architecture for EEG report generation to reduce hallucinations, but it only evaluates model performance across retrospective benchmark datasets without testing an operational deployment practice.
